title: hatpi_neo_2026ed138: analysis code for "HATPI Detection of 2026 ED138"
description: Analysis code for the Research Note of the AAS "HATPI Detection of 2026 ED138". Given a JPL Horizons ephemeris and a list of HATPI difference images (with kernels, photometric references, WCS references and zero points), it measures the trans-Neptunian object 2026 ED138 by (1) light-curve-based stacking: forced fiphot aperture photometry at the predicted position in every image, corrected for static subtraction residuals, combined per observing season; and (2) image-based stacking: residual-corrected cutouts shifted onto the predicted position and stacked per season. Significances and magnitude uncertainties come from 20 control positions moving with the target. The code produces the per-season photometry table and the figure of the Note. The repository contains the Python package (hatpi_neo/), a command-line driver (run_analysis.py), the Horizons ephemeris and the list of the 1498 HATPI stacked difference images used (examples/2026ED138/), and a README describing all files, formats, column units and data sources. The HATPI images themselves are not included. Requires Python 3 (numpy, scipy, astropy, matplotlib) and fiphot (fitsh/HATpipe, version 0.9zc or later).
